$comment: Kit performance budgets. Measured baseline 2026-10-12 (raw/gzip bytes): worker entry 2551/1219; server JS total (22 files, no sourcemaps) 962157/258300 — dominated by the Hono catch-all bundle (chunks/hono.js 433009); client JS total (11 files) 100252/39302; client CSS total (1 file) 2402/763. Ceilings are measured size x1.25 rounded up (raw to 512B, gzip to 256B), the repository x1.25 rule from ci/bundle-budget.json. Client/server hashed-asset groups are budgeted as totals plus a file-count cap, so a new chunk fails closed instead of escaping enforcement. Startup.maxMs (60s, the same cold-start bound as ci/kit-worker-e2e.mjs's listen) is enforced as the Kit webServer readiness timeout in playwright.kit-parity.config.ts; the parity spec additionally records warm first-200 latency as a report annotation under a 10s liveness bound. Raising a ceiling needs an explicit decision explaining the growth; never relax a budget to make CI green. 2026-10-13 decision (join landing): main measures 31 server files and the /join route adds 5 (2 page entries + 1 SvelteKit node + Vite re-partitioning the shared 437k Hono catch-all into chunks/src.js and splitting chunks/kit-session.js for the flash/widget load) for 36 total; byte totals fit with ~15% margin (raw 1014543, gzip 275405), so only the file-count cap moves from 32 to 45 (36 x1.25). 2026-10-13 decision (hotzones + member leaderboard): this branch adds 3 Kit routes (hotzones main, hotzones [signal], leaderboards/members) on top of main's 36 server / 15 client files; branch build measured 50 server files and 19 client files, byte totals fit with margin (server raw 1066638/gzip ~292k under 1203200/323072; client raw 120286/gzip ~48k under 125440/49152 after moving WEEKDAY_NAMES to the client-safe src/hotzones/weekday-names.ts so drizzle-orm no longer bundles into the client — without that fix the client measured 164058/58614). File-count caps moved from 45 to 63 (50 x1.25) server and 16 to 24 (19 x1.25) client. 2026-10-13 decision (merge main with join-port #826): that merged tree built 45 server files and 18 client files, below branch-only 50/19 because the join-port re-partitioned shared chunks; caps tightened to 57/23 (45/18 x1.25 rounded up). Byte totals fit unchanged ceilings (server raw 1058858/gzip 289484 under 1203200/323072; client raw 116282/gzip 46668 under 125440/49152, drizzle-orm still out of the client via src/hotzones/weekday-names.ts). 2026-10-13 decision (auth recover on main): the /auth/recover page adds 1 structural client node (csr=false, never hydrated; main build raw 114167/125440, gzip 45967/49152), moving the client file cap from 16 to 22 (17 x1.25). 2026-10-13 decision (merge current main into member leaderboard): the exact merged tree builds 59 server files (raw 1080381/gzip 300538) and 20 client JS files (raw 122464/gzip 49906). The server files and client file count move to 74 and 25 (x1.25, rounded up); client JS byte ceilings move to 153600 raw and 62464 gzip (x1.25 rounded up to 512/256-byte boundaries) to accommodate the measured combined route set with the same fail-closed margin. Worker and server byte ceilings remain unchanged. 2026-10-13 decision (merge main leaderboard #823 into profile reads #831): the exact merged tree builds 70 server files (raw 1101847/gzip 308665, under 1203200/323072) and 25 client JS files (raw 141601/gzip 57542, under 165376/66560). Byte ceilings unchanged (fit with margin, tighter than x1.25 = fail-closed). File-count caps move per the x1.25 rule: server 74 to 88 (70 x1.25), client 27 to 32 (25 x1.25). Growth is legitimate: main's hotzones/leaderboard/recover Kit routes plus this PR's two disabled-manifest profile-read routes sharing ProfileView. 2026-10-13 decision (homepage port merged with current main): fresh merged build measures 76 server files (raw 1120271/gzip 316660) and 26 client JS files (raw 153855/gzip 62486), versus main's profile baseline above (70/25 files, 1101847/308665 server and 141601/57542 client). Homepage adds 6 server files and 1 client file (18424/7995 server and 12254/4944 client raw/gzip); all remain within existing ceilings, so no ceiling moves. 2026-10-13 decision (content-leaf LCP fix): the leaf repair scopes every Display text rule with :not(.content-theme) and keeps the font preload off content leaves; the guarded CSS rides the Hono catch-all into the Kit server bundle, measuring 84 files at raw 1136039/gzip 323060-323063 against the 323072 gzip ceiling (main measures 322993, so the pre-existing margin was 79B, and identical-source rebuilds wobble ±3B). Only the server gzip ceiling moves, one 256B boundary step to 323328; raw, file-count and all other ceilings stay fixed and fail-closed. 2026-10-13 decision (about page Kit port): the /about route adds 3 server files (page server and svelte entries plus the about-content chunk, ~3.4kB raw) with no database, session or client-hydrated modules (csr=false; worker and client groups still fit unchanged, server raw 1136397B fits 1203200B); this head builds 89 server files at gzip 325231B, over the 88-file and 323072B ceilings. File-count cap moves 88 to 112 (89 x1.25) and server gzip moves 323072 to 406784 (325231 x1.25 rounded up to 256B); raw unchanged. 2026-10-13 reconciliation (about port + content-leaf LCP fix): retain both historical decisions; the merged tree measures 89 server files at raw 1140149B/gzip 325331B, with worker and client groups still fitting. No numeric ceiling changes from the about-port head.
